Everyone loved Dolly Parton because Dolly Parton honestly loved everyone. (Which is very different from liking everyone.) Astronomers put galaxies into three main categories: spirals like our own Milky Way with arms emanating from their cores, ellipticals that are older and likely the results of mergers, and irregulars that can encompass a wide range of galactic phenomena.
